2e87a4d8b6f2.title: Incomplete Validation
2e87a4d8b6f2.reason: An empty or blank baseUrl fails the demo's check: it must match ^https?://[^/\s]+ after trimming, the same rule the server applies with a parsed URL and a host.

6d2179070d82.title: Missing Validation
6d2179070d82.reason: A key file may be added after the provider (a Docker secret mounted on the next start), so a missing file is allowed on purpose; the provider's row says whether the key was found (hasKey), and the path is limited to the secret folders.

871323b85125.title: Resource Leak
871323b85125.reason: The file handle is dropped at the end of the match arm, which closes it (std::fs::File has no close method); write_all's error is checked, so nothing is left open.

bc7b314940a4.title: Hard-coded Secret
bc7b314940a4.reason: No secret: STARTTLS on 587 is only the default when KOMPANION_SMTP_TLS is unset; tls (465) and none are taken from the environment, and the port follows the choice. The test covers both.

cc6a11a4ff3e.title: Possible Issue
cc6a11a4ff3e.reason: rem_euclid is what makes west-of-UTC right: 01:00 UTC at UTC-5 is 20:00 the evening before, which is the user's local time; the quiet-hours test checks offsets and a span over midnight.
